main_text.l: PARALLELUM II.

præits predicant. Nam si fides divina (de-

page.notes: The line "pythagorici" is printed as shown; "laici in papatu" has a printed star after laici. The word "præditicant" in the source reads "praedicant"; the transcription above follows the visible text, with "hi Magiftri" set as printed. Several words near the lower right are partly obscured by the page curl and are uncertain. The rule above the heading is an ornament, not text.
